title: Strict evidence-only RAG mode (per request + dataset defaults)
description: Add a strict grounding mode that enforces 'visible evidence only' semantics per chat request and via dataset rag_defaults. When enabled: force abstain on weak evidence, run post-gen claim check, and ensure structured_output is also verified (no hallucinated fields). Expose as ChatRAGConfig + DatasetRAGDefaults fields and propagate through LangChain engine + LangGraph pipeline. Add tests + docs.
